title: Bootstrap: Go module, CLI skeleton, CI, pinned contract bundle 3.0.0 with a Go reader per contract
description: Go module github.com/pengelbrecht/ticfac (stdlib-first). CLI ticfac with run-epic <id> that fails closed ("no executor configured", exit 2) and version --json. CI (GitHub Actions): go test -short ./..., go vet, and a contracts job that fetches pengelbrecht/ticks at a pinned ref (contracts/ at bundle 3.0.0, mode pinned — see cloud/factory/contracts.pin.json and contracts/CHANGELOG.md in ticks for the pin shape and the rule) into a vendored contracts/ directory, verifies digests, and runs every reader. A ticfac Go reader (test) for EVERY bundle file: job-protocol, ticfac-run-state (incl. the 7 CAS sequences over a git fake), lifecycle-invariants (13 named tests over the fake harness), tk-json-manifest, credential-ownership, tracker-layout, collect-vocabulary, worker-boot-contract, message-context, runners-config-contract, sandbox-image-cases, signal-source-cases, sweep-policy-cases, sweep-selection-contract. Port the strict JSON-Schema-subset validator (ticks internal/tkcontract/schema.go semantics: 10 keywords, unknown keyword is a parse error) into internal/schema. This tick owns go.mod/go.sum and the contracts/ vendoring for the wave.
notes: 2026-09-02 20:05 - decision: Which ticks ref pins contract bundle 3.0.0? → 5d14bcb76de720cd9465e2f88ba4aadc3917cc7b (ticks origin/main at run start) — bundle.json at that commit is 3.0.0; tick text named the version but not the ref
acceptance_criteria: go build ./... and go test -short ./... green; ticfac run-epic x exits 2 with the fail-closed message; CI green on main with the contracts job verifying bundle 3.0.0 digests and running all 14 readers; a deliberately broken vendored fixture fails CI (recorded in a tick note with the run URL).
